props.animation_script:
(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][InfectiousBile]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

// =========================

// Asset paths

// =========================

const MONSTER_SFX_SRC =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster2.ogg";

const POISON_SFX_SRC =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Poison.ogg";

const BREATH_VFX_SRC =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Breath_Weapon/BreathWeapon_Acid01_Regular_Green_30ft_Line_Burst_1200x200.webm";

// =========================

// Timing

// =========================

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const DIM_FADE_IN_MS = 250;

const BREATH_HOLD_MS = 7100;

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const DIM_FADE_OUT_MS = 250;

const END_BUFFER_MS = 80;

// =========================

// Tuning knobs

// =========================

const SLIDE_DISTANCE = 120;

const DIM_ALPHA = 0.72;

// Breath placement knobs

const BREATH_OFFSET_X = 80;

const BREATH_OFFSET_Y = -6;

const BREATH_SCALE_X = 1.0;

const BREATH_SCALE_Y = 1.0;

// Breath spin knobs

// Total sweep is clamped to max 180 degrees.

const BREATH_SPIN_SWEEP_DEGREES = 180;

const BREATH_SPIN_CYCLES = 2.25;

// Layering

const DIM_Z_INDEX = 100;

const CLONE_Z_INDEX = 5000;

const BREATH_Z_INDEX = 5002;

// SFX volume

const MONSTER_SFX_VOL = 0.6;

const POISON_SFX_VOL = 0.7;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc ?? null;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

function getDisp(token) {

const d = token?.actor?.document?.disposition;

return d === -1 ? -1 : 1;

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "oni.infectiousBile",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

const disp = getDisp(sourceToken);

const signedSlideDx = disp === -1 ? -SLIDE_DISTANCE : +SLIDE_DISTANCE;

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function degToRad(deg) {

return (deg * Math.PI) / 180;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function fadeAlpha(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.alpha = from + (to - from) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

const sy = sprite.scale.y || 1;

sprite.scale.set(flipped ? -sx : sx, sy);

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.cloneZIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

function createBlackDimmer() {

const w = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const h = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

g.drawRect(0, 0, w, h);

g.endFill();

g.x = 0;

g.y = 0;

g.alpha = 0;

g.zIndex = Number(params.dimZIndex ?? 100);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(g);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return g;

}

function startBreathSpin(root, params) {

const holdMs = Number(params.breathHoldMs ?? 7100);

const cycles = Number(params.breathSpinCycles ?? 2.25);

// Clamp total sweep to max 180 degrees.

const totalSweepDeg = Math.min(

Math.max(Number(params.breathSpinSweepDeg ?? 180), 0),

180

);

const halfRangeRad = degToRad(totalSweepDeg / 2);

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / holdMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

// Oscillate inside the clamped sweep window.

const angle = Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2 * cycles) * halfRangeRad;

root.rotation = angle;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

root.rotation = 0;

}

};

ticker.add(update);

return () => {

ticker.remove(update);

root.rotation = 0;

};

}

async function createBreathVfx(originSprite, flipped, src) {

const texture = await loadTexture(src);

// Root container is the rotation pivot.

const root = new PIXI.Container();

const facingSign = flipped ? 1 : -1;

root.x = originSprite.x + (facingSign * Number(params.breathOffsetX ?? 0));

root.y = originSprite.y + Number(params.breathOffsetY ?? 0);

root.alpha = 1;

root.rotation = 0;

root.zIndex = Number(params.breathZIndex ?? 5002);

// Sprite is anchored on its LEFT side so the spin point is clamped there.

const breath = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

breath.anchor.set(0, 0.5);

breath.x = 0;

breath.y = 0;

breath.scale.set(

Math.abs(Number(params.breathScaleX ?? 1)) * facingSign,

Number(params.breathScaleY ?? 1)

);

root.addChild(breath);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(root);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

const media = texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (media) {

try {

media.muted = true;

media.loop = false;

media.currentTime = 0;

} catch (_) {}

if (typeof media.play === "function") {

const playPromise = media.play();

if (playPromise?.catch) playPromise.catch(() => {});

}

}

const stopSpin = startBreathSpin(root, params);

return { root, breath, stopSpin };

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const nativeFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

let clone = null;

let dimmer = null;

let breathFx = null;

try {

clone = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.slideDx ?? 0),

y: home.y

};

// 1) slide forward slightly

await animateXY(

clone,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// 2) dim the screen

dimmer = createBlackDimmer();

await fadeAlpha(

dimmer,

0,

Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.7),

Number(params.dimFadeInMs ?? 250)

);

// 3) breath VFX from caster clone

breathFx = await createBreathVfx(

clone,

nativeFlipX,

params.breathVfxSrc

);

// 4) hold for the VFX window

await wait(Number(params.breathHoldMs ?? 7100));

// cleanup breath before return

try {

breathFx?.stopSpin?.();

} catch (_) {}

try {

const source = breathFx?.breath?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (breathFx?.root?.parent) breathFx.root.parent.removeChild(breathFx.root);

} catch (_) {}

try {

breathFx?.root?.destroy({ children: true });

} catch (_) {}

breathFx = null;

// 5) slide back

await animateXY(

clone,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? 320)

);

// 6) undim after returning

if (dimmer) {

await fadeAlpha(

dimmer,

dimmer.alpha ?? Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.7),

0,

Number(params.dimFadeOutMs ?? 250)

);

}

} finally {

try {

breathFx?.stopSpin?.();

} catch (_) {}

try {

const source = breathFx?.breath?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (breathFx?.root?.parent) breathFx.root.parent.removeChild(breathFx.root);

} catch (_) {}

try {

breathFx?.root?.destroy({ children: true });

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (dimmer?.parent) dimmer.parent.removeChild(dimmer);

} catch (_) {}

try {

dimmer?.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

if (clone) {

try {

if (clone.parent) clone.parent.removeChild(clone);

} catch (_) {}

try {

clone.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.infectiousBile.slideDimBreathReturn",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: {

slideDx: signedSlideDx,

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

dimAlpha: DIM_ALPHA,

dimFadeInMs: DIM_FADE_IN_MS,

dimFadeOutMs: DIM_FADE_OUT_MS,

breathHoldMs: BREATH_HOLD_MS,

breathVfxSrc: BREATH_VFX_SRC,

breathOffsetX: BREATH_OFFSET_X,

breathOffsetY: BREATH_OFFSET_Y,

breathScaleX: BREATH_SCALE_X,

breathScaleY: BREATH_SCALE_Y,

breathSpinSweepDeg: BREATH_SPIN_SWEEP_DEGREES,

breathSpinCycles: BREATH_SPIN_CYCLES,

dimZIndex: DIM_Z_INDEX,

cloneZIndex: CLONE_Z_INDEX,

breathZIndex: BREATH_Z_INDEX

},

meta: {

source: "InfectiousBile",

monsterSfx: MONSTER_SFX_SRC,

poisonSfx: POISON_SFX_SRC,

breathVfx: BREATH_VFX_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + DIM_FADE_IN_MS)

.sound()

.file(MONSTER_SFX_SRC)

.volume(MONSTER_SFX_VOL)

.wait(BREATH_HOLD_MS)

.sound()

.file(POISON_SFX_SRC)

.volume(POISON_SFX_VOL);

sfxSeq.play();

const TOTAL_MS =

MOVE_OUT_MS +

DIM_FADE_IN_MS +

BREATH_HOLD_MS +

MOVE_BACK_MS +

DIM_FADE_OUT_MS +

END_BUFFER_MS;

await wait(TOTAL_MS);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.", { TOTAL_MS });

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "oni.infectiousBile",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();
